title: Backlog Artifact Audience + Register
description: The controlled vocabulary for the AUDIENCE + REGISTER of an artifact dispatch — whether it's a required, orchestrator-supplied input or may legitimately arrive absent is flow-project-management's own rule (P1), not restated here. Two orthogonal dimensions: `audience` (who reads/acts on it) and, when a human reads it, `register` (their relationship to the work). The MATRIX semantics for a backlog artifact (how each audience changes it) live in the standard-backlog-artifacts skill; the semantics for a documentation artifact live with tech-writer/flow-documentation instead — this file defines the value domains only, for both consumers. Reference a co-located consumer via {"$ref": "audience-register.schema.json#/$defs/rendered"}.

audience.description: Who will read/act on the artifact.

register.description: When a human reads it, their relationship to the work. Moot when audience is `agent`.

rendered.description: The composite audience+register token as written on an artifact and passed in a delegation.
rendered.$comment: Enumerated by hand, not composed via $ref/oneOf from `audience`/`register`: JSON Schema has no construct that concatenates two sibling enums into one string token. Keep in sync with those two $defs by hand if either changes.
